# Yazh Academy of Music & Fine Arts

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Yazh Academy of Music & Fine Arts?
North Mada Street, Madambakkam, Chennai 600 126.

### What facilities does Yazh Academy of Music & Fine Arts have?
Bharatanatyam, Western dance, Yoga, Keyboard, Drawing, Violin, Vocal, Veenai, Mrithangam, Flute, Drums, Guitar, Online classes.

### What can I learn?
Bharatanatyam, western dance, yoga, keyboard, drawing, violin, vocal, veenai, mrithangam, flute, drums and guitar.

### Do you teach online?
Yes — students from other states and countries learn with us online.

### Who is your director?
Mr. S. Prabakaran, awarded the Sangeetha Vidwan title at the Tamil Nadu Government Music College.

### How do I join Yazh Academy of Music & Fine Arts?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98848 88286.
